name: The Island
extentNote: PLAN 5: from Heelsum in the west to Pannerden in the east, and from north of Arnhem to Groesbeek and Overasselt in the south. Widened to take in Ginkel Heath (DZ Y) in the north-west and the ground south of Groesbeek (DZ N).
